data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic 'Mathildis', meaning 'mighty in battle'. In Christian tradition, Saint Matildis is revered for her strength and courage. The name Matildis carries the meaning “Powerful in battle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Matildis usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful in battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner fortitude and spiritual resilience.
data.etymology: Matildis belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful in battle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Matildis total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: מטילדיס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מטילדיס הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו במילה הגרמנית 'Mahthild', שמורכבת מ' maht 'שפירושו'עוצמה'ו' hild 'שפירושו'קרב'. השם קשור למושגים של כוח ועוז, שמקורם במילות השורש העבריות 'עז' ו'אל'. במסגרת השפה העברית, השם מטילדיס מתורגם כ'אלוהים הוא עוזרי', ומבטא את הרעיון של עוצמה וסמכות אלוהית.

in_greek.name: Ματίλδη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ματίλδη προέρχεται από τις Γερμανικές ρίζες 'maht' που σημαίνει 'δύναμη' και 'hild' που σημαίνει 'μάχη'. Στην Ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Ματίλδη μεταφράζεται ως 'Θεοδυναμένη' ή 'ισχυρά κυρία', που σημαίνει 'κυρία με την δύναμη του Θεού' ή 'η ισχυρή κυρία'. Αυτό το όνομα συνδέεται με την χριστιανική παράδοση και εκφράζει την έννοια της πνευματικής δύναμης και της υποστήριξης του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Matildis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Matildis origine Germanico derivatur a vocibus 'maht' quod significat 'potentia' et 'hild' quod significat 'proelium'. In traditione Christiana Latina, nomen Matildis interpretatur ut 'Dei potens' vel 'fortis domina', quae vim et potestatem divinam exprimit. Hoc nomen usitatum est in Ecclesia Christiana et habetur in catalogo nominum sanctarum mulierum.

in_english.name: Matildis
in_english.long_meaning: The name Matildis originates from Germanic roots 'maht' meaning 'might' and 'hild' meaning 'battle'. In Christian tradition, Matildis is interpreted as 'mighty in battle' or 'powerful lady', conveying the idea of spiritual strength and divine support. This name has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing feminine power and faith.

data.cultural_impact: Saint Matildis' name reflects the power and resilience of women during medieval times, inspiring whatever society she is part of to value the strength and abilities of women in leadership and conflict resolution.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Matildis" symbolizes a spirit of bravery and determination, reminding us of the courage and faith of Saint Matildis in defending her beliefs and advancing the cause of Christianity. It serves as a reminder to be strong in our faith and unwavering in our convictions.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Matildis: Daughter of Might and Battle. Bold in faith and steadfast in spirit, she embodies strength and resilience in the face of adversity.

historical_references.reference: Matildis of Tours was a 7th century saint and abbess. She was born in 620 and became a nun at the Monastery of the Holy Cross in Poitiers. She was later elected as abbess and ruled with great wisdom and piety. She died in 679 and was later canonized.

Matilda of Canossa (1025-1111) was a German noblewoman and countess of the Marquise of Tuscany. She was a major patron of the arts and built many castles, churches, and monasteries. She was also known for her political acumen and was a powerful figure in the Holy Roman Empire.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Matildis, with its rich history and association with strength and leadership, has seen a modern resurgence in various platforms. On social media, users draw inspiration from the name's royal past and use it as a unique username or handle. Blogs and websites, particularly those focused on history or women's issues, feature articles on Matildis and her impact on history. In literature, Matildis is a popular name for characters in historical fiction or fantasy novels, often portrayed as strong and independent women. The name's modern usage reflects a broader trend towards reviving classic names, celebrating historical heroes, and embracing gender-neutral names.
